mapper.select:
WITH T_PN AS ( ), -- normal stock T00 AS ( SELECT STOCK.STOFCY_0 AS StockSite, STOCK.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SUM(STOCK.QTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY STOCK.ITMREF_0, STOCK.STOFCY_0 ) AS Qty, 'NORM' AS Type FROM T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.STOCK STOCK ON STOCK.ITMREF_0 = T_PN.PN WHERE STOCK.STA_0 != 'RE'
-- Repair return stock UNION SELECT STOCK.STOFCY_0 AS StockSite, STOCK.ITMREF_0 + '(RE)' AS PN, SUM(STOCK.QTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY STOCK.ITMREF_0, STOCK.STOFCY_0 ) AS Qty, 'RE' AS Type FROM T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.STOCK STOCK ON T_PN.PN = STOCK.ITMREF_0 WHERE STOCK.STA_0 = 'RE'
-- purchase stock UNION SELECT PORDERQ.POHFCY_0 AS StockSite, PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 + '(PO)' AS PN, SUM(QTYSTU_0 - RCPQTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY PORDERQ.ITMREF_0, PORDERQ.POHFCY_0 ) AS Qty, 'PO' AS Type FROM T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ PORDERQ ON T_PN.PN = PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER AS PORDER ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 WHERE WIPSTA_0 IN (1, 2) --exclude completed/cloased order AND QTYSTU_0 - RCPQTYSTU_0 > 0
) SELECT * FROM T00 ORDER BY StockSite DESC, Type DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY STOJOU.STOFCY_0 DESC, STOJOU.CREDAT_0 DESC, STOJOU.CSTCOU_0 DESC ) AS ItemNO, STOJOU.STOFCY_0 AS StockSite, STOJOU.LOC_0 AS Location, STOJOU.CSTCOU_0 AS Seq, STOJOU.ITMREF_0 AS PN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description, STOJOU.QTYSTU_0 AS Qty, STOJOU.STU_0 AS Unit, ROUND(STOJOU.AMTVAL_0, 2) AS Cost, STOJOU.PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, STOJOU.VCRNUMORI_0 AS SourceNO, STOJOU.VCRLINORI_0 AS SourceLine, STOJOU.VCRNUM_0 AS EntryNO, STOJOU.VCRLIN_0 AS EntryLine, STOJOU.CREUSR_0 AS CreateUser, STOJOU.CREDAT_0 AS CreateDate FROM EXPLOIT.STOJOU STOJOU LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = STOJOU.ITMREF_0 WHERE STOJOU.STOFCY_0 = #{Site} AND ( STOJOU.CREDAT_0 BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE, #{DateFrom}, 23) AND CONVERT(DATE, #{DateTo}, 23) )
AND ( STOJOU.ITMREF_0 LIKE #{PnOrName} OR ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 LIKE #{PnOrName} OR ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 LIKE #{PnOrName} )
-- 6: Receive -- 10: workorder -- 17: Supplier Invoice AND STOJOU.VCRTYPREG_0 != 17 ORDER BY ItemNO ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT STOCK.LOC_0 AS Location, STOCK.ITMREF_0 AS PN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 != '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0, '' ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 != '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0, '' ) AS Description, ( SELECT STRING_AGG (t.OptionPN, ';') FROM ( SELECT ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS WHERE ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 = STOCK.ITMREF_0 AND ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0 UNION SELECT ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS WHERE ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0 = STOCK.ITMREF_0 AND ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0 UNION SELECT T2.ITMREFBPS_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS T1 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMBPS T2 ON T1.ITMREF_0 = T2.ITMREF_0 WHERE T1.ITMREFBPS_0 = STOCK.ITMREF_0 AND T2.ITMREFBPS_0 != STOCK.ITMREF_0 ) t ) AS OptionPN, SUM(STOCK.QTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY STOCK.STOFCY_0, STOCK.ITMREF_0, STOCK.LOC_0 ) AS Qty FROM EXPLOIT.STOCK STOCK LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = STOCK.ITMREF_0 WHERE STOCK.STA_0 != 'RE'
